requirements.text: Ensure full compliance with PSD2, including strong customer authentication for payments and self-service features.
Adhere to GDPR by sharing only necessary details in real-time transaction notifications while maintaining customer privacy and data usage transparency.
Implement account management features, such as card freezing, that comply with PSD2 regulatory standards.
Integrate new features with the existing core banking system without making major changes.
Conduct thorough evaluations of all proposed features against regulatory requirements to mitigate compliance risks.
